two-dimensional MD simulations are conducted with Large-scale Atomic/Molecular Massively Parallel Simulator, LAMMPS, on Ni-based superalloys using the Mishin EAM potentials
after performing an energy minimization for each system using the conjugate gradient (CG) method, the atoms are relaxed in two steps, each taking 60 ps with a constant time step of 3 fs
The first relaxation is carried out by applying a Nose-Hoover thermostat through the NVT ensemble with the temperature damping parameter of 10 times the time step.
the second relaxation includes applying a Nose-Hoover barostat through the NPT ensemble with the stress damping parameter of 1000 times the time step
10 different uniaxial tensile stresses are applied to the simulation box in the y direction. The considered sequence of stresses ranges from 0.5 to 5.0 GPa with a common difference of 0.5 GPa.
